name: Broens Gadekøkken
recommendation: This is an open-air space, but there are heaters installed around tables under a roof. There is also currently a small skating rink there. The food there mostly represents some of the small but very good cafe’s in town - District Tonkin (Vietnamese), Gasoline Grill (burgers), Phago (wraps) - but there are also a few others that are their own small operators. Generally worth the time, but the outside nature of this space can get a bit challenging in the winter.
